name: Pawna (Pavna) Landing
notes: nice flat grassy lakeside flat with non-jagged rocks intermittently appearing.

name: Rishikesh - Kunjapuri Landing
notes: You can not see the landing from takeoff which is below you to the left of Rishikesh. Main landing just up river of Lakshman Jula in Rishikesh on a sand bank next to the Ganges river. Landing is about 6km from take of and if you catch no lift you may fall short of landing. In this case find any rice field and keep a careful eye for power lines which plague the Indian landscape. These fields can be deceptively small.

name: Yelagiri Landing
notes: Common designated for both NW & SW launch sites. LZ is located by the side of a large pond & very close to the Tourist park.

name: Pavagadh Landing
notes: 240 m ASL

name: Saputara Landing
notes: Landing is in the fields about 400M below the takeoff.

name: Vagamon - Main Ridge Landing
notes: Top-landing is the main option. It is easy as there is plenty of room clear of obstacles. Just make sure you stay away of the areas that might have rotor. Bottom landing is also possible, but landing sites are few and going back up to the take off area is not so easy.

name: Kodungallur PG Site Landing
notes:
Lot of landing options along the beachfront. Wind usually start from east in the morning and turn to blow from SW at 11, then W and from NW after 2 pm. Speed varies from 5kms/hr to 15 kms/hr.  Can fly about 30 kms along the wide beachfront with lot of emergency landing options.
Motorable road upto the landing.

name: Tungareshwar Landing
notes: There are plenty of landing options in gliding distance. You can choose an area close to the road and make your landing approcah.

name: Tokpada Landing
notes: Since it is a huge open flatland one can land anywhere. No obstructions on the field.

name: Agashi Paddy fields Landing
notes: This is a huge open field suitable for ground handling and winching

name: Mount Abu Landing
notes: There are several good LZ below the village is called 'Anadra village' the best place to land is in front of the temple â€œBhairu tarak dham â€œ it is a Jain temple and one can get a nice cup of tea at the nearby local stall.. This side of the mountain is ideal for SW winds which are prevalent from March to October.

name: Arna Landing
notes: open field in front

name: Pushkar Landing
notes: landing on the dunes behind the town for SW and W winds.

name: Bavarli Landing
notes: Vast landing fields all over

name: Visapur Landing
notes: Loads of landing options in the fields below takeoff. Avoid landing too close to the village & in fields with standing crops.

name: Kone Landing
notes: Lots of landing places

name: Saputara Governor Hill Landing
notes: At the large ground, also used as helipad.

name: Roopmati Pavilion Landing
notes: Below in the valley, need to arrange pickup vehicle as there is no local transport available

name: Panchgani Landing
notes:
TOP-landing can be done with 'mild' winds.
But many incidents/ accidents have happend while pilots attempted to topland in inadequate
conditions!! If in any doubt: land 'below'.

name: Ghayabari Tea Garden, Kurseong Landing
notes:
Rohini - Kurseong

610 mts Asl
26.8502 N; 
88.2944 E

name: Hoskote Lake Bed Landing
notes: Flat dry lake bed.

name: Captain Hill Yadamadu Landing
notes:
East side landing area is limited and is in fields.
West side landing area is huge and is in fields.

name: Raghav Hill Landing
notes: Landing zone is in the fields in front of the hill.

name: panvel uran road Landing
notes: good

name: Saptashrungi Landing
notes: Landing possible all around in the farm fields below.

name: Bandla Landing
notes: landing is in Luhanu ground , this is very big and safe play ground near cricket stadium Bilaspur city.

name: Trimbak Godavari Ridge Landing
notes: Multiple landing options, including top landing(when not much thermic)

name: Zanzroli Landing
notes: In case of top to bottom flights landing are in small zones where on has to use his skills to maneuver the glider with good speed to landing zone. In case of good soaring flights there are multiple choices for landing.

name: Deolai Landing
notes: There are multiple spots suitable for landing at the base of the mountain. Watch out for barbed wire fences.You will need to walk about half to one mile to the landing parking location shown. The walk is through some private agricultural fields. Please be courteous, if you come across some locals and be mindful of their crops/livestock.

name: Shinde Training Hill Landing
notes: Landing site for training flights from Shinde Training Hill

name: Tower Hill Landing
notes:
Good landing area.
240mt below Launch.

name: Billing - Bir Landing
notes: The official landing zone is at the edge of Bir Tibetan Colony at ~1400M. It is also known as sunset ground.

name: Arambol Landing
notes: Landing is either back on top or on one of the beaches. If you've had enough and choose a beach its best to land close to a bar. ;)

name: Nandi Hills Landing
notes:
Plenty of open fields all around the hills.However be very careful of power lines & fences. Please do not land in fields with crops. We have designated LZ's which facilitates easy retrieval.
More info on www.flynandi.com
